title: Frequently Asked Questions
text: Can't find what you're looking for? Our support team is always happy to help.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: Orders are usually delivered within 2-5 business days inside the country. You will get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

items.question: Is shipping really free?
items.answer: Yes. All orders over $50 qualify for free shipping. For orders below $50, a small flat shipping fee is added at checkout.

items.question: What is your return policy?
items.answer: You can return any unused item in its original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or an exchange.

items.question: Are your products authentic and good quality?
items.answer: Every accessory is quality-checked before it leaves our store. If an item arrives damaged or not as described, we will replace it at no extra cost.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, mobile wallets and cash on delivery. All online payments are encrypted and 100% secure.
